``` {r setup, include=FALSE}
# ==============================================================================
# 1. Global Configuration & Environment
# ==============================================================================
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
options(scipen = 999, digits = 4)

# Options configuration: Sum-to-zero contrasts for valid Type III ANOVA results 
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Global Settings & Analysis Targets
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
analysis_name <- "CrossExp_E1_vs_E2"

# Component definitions (Intersection of E1 and E2 valid components)
# N170 is excluded because E1 does not have a valid Stimulus-Locked N170.
shared_components <- c(
  "EPN"       = TRUE,
  "FRN"       = TRUE,
  "N400"      = TRUE,
  "LPP_offer" = TRUE
)

if(!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(
  here, readr, readxl, dplyr, tidyr, stringr,  # Data Wrangling
  lme4, lmerTest,                              # Modeling
  car, parameters, performance,                # Diagnostics & APA Extraction
  buildmer,                                    # Random Structure Optimization
  emmeans, effectsize,                         # Statistical Inference
  sjPlot, sjmisc,                              # Quick Visualization
  ggplot2, ggpubr, gridExtra,                  # Publication Visualization
  openxlsx                                     # Excel Reporting
)

emmeans::emm_options(lmerTest.limit = 50000, pbkrtest.limit = 50000)

out_root <- here("results", "EEG", paste0(analysis_name, "_Stats_Regression"))
if(!dir.exists(out_root)) dir.create(out_root, recursive = TRUE)

theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 14) + 
          theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "top"))

colors_emo <- c('neu'="#8491B4",'aff'="#91D1C2",'dis'="#E64B35",'dom'="#F39B7F",'enj'="#3C5488")
labels_emo <- c('neu'='Neutral','aff'='Affiliative','dis'='Disgust','dom'='Dominance','enj'='Reward')
colors_off <- c('fair'="#2E86AB",'unfair'="#A23B72")
labels_off <- c('fair'='Fair', 'unfair'='Unfair')

custom_control <- lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 200000), calc.derivs = FALSE)

```

```{r apa-module}
# ==============================================================================
# Helper Functions for APA Formatting
# ==============================================================================
format_anova_apa <- function(anova_obj) {
  df_res <- as.data.frame(anova_obj) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("Effect")
  
  es_df <- data.frame(Parameter = character(), Eta2_partial = numeric())
  tryCatch({
    es <- effectsize::eta_squared(anova_obj, partial = TRUE, ci = 0.95, verbose = FALSE)
    es_df <- as.data.frame(es) %>% select(Parameter, Eta2_partial)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
  
  if(nrow(es_df) > 0) df_res <- left_join(df_res, es_df, by = c("Effect" = "Parameter")) else df_res$Eta2_partial <- NA
  
  get_col <- function(col_name) if(col_name %in% names(df_res)) df_res[[col_name]] else NA
  
  df_res %>%
    mutate(
      F_val  = get_col("F value"), NumDF  = get_col("NumDF"), DenDF  = get_col("DenDF"), p_val  = get_col("Pr(>F)"),
      p_str = case_when(is.na(p_val) ~ "-", p_val < .001 ~ "< .001", TRUE ~ paste0("= ", sprintf("%.3f", p_val))),
      Eta_str = ifelse(is.na(Eta2_partial), "-", sprintf("%.2f", Eta2_partial)),
      APA_Report = case_when(!is.na(F_val) ~ sprintf("F(%s, %.2f) = %.2f, p %s, np2 = %s", NumDF, DenDF, F_val, p_str, Eta_str), TRUE ~ "Error")
    ) %>% select(Effect, APA_Report, F_value = F_val, NumDF, DenDF, p_value = p_val, Eta2_partial)
}

format_posthoc_apa <- function(emm_df) {
  df_clean <- as.data.frame(emm_df)
  if("t.ratio" %in% names(df_clean)) {
    df_clean <- df_clean %>%
      mutate(
        p_str = case_when(p.value < .001 ~ "< .001", TRUE ~ paste0("= ", sprintf("%.3f", p.value))),
        t_str = sprintf("%.2f", t.ratio), df_str = sprintf("%.2f", df), 
        estimate_col = if("estimate" %in% names(.)) estimate else if("response" %in% names(.)) response else NA,
        estimate_str = sprintf("%.2f", estimate_col), se_str = sprintf("%.2f", SE),
        Stats_String = sprintf("b = %s (SE=%s), t(%s) = %s, p %s", estimate_str, se_str, df_str, t_str, p_str)
      )
  }
  return(df_clean)
}
```

```{r prep-functions}
# ==============================================================================
# Data Loading & Cleaning Functions (Adapted for Cross-Experiment Merge)
# ==============================================================================

load_and_prep_single <- function(path_erp, erp_name, baseline_col, exp_label) {
  if(!file.exists(path_erp)) return(NULL)
  df <- read_csv(path_erp, show_col_types=FALSE)
  if(!(erp_name %in% names(df))) return(NULL)
  
  # Non-destructive ID Generation & Standardization:
  # Extracts only digits from original participant_id (ignoring 'VP' or 'Vp' inconsistencies).
  # Creates a NEW column 'Subject_ID_Mega' to act as the universal clustering key.
  df <- df %>%
    filter(Offers_Other %in% c(5, 6, 8, 9)) %>%
    mutate(
      Numeric_ID = as.numeric(str_extract(participant_id, "\\d+")),
      Subject_ID_Mega = sprintf("%s_Vp%04d", exp_label, Numeric_ID),
      offer_type = factor(case_when(Offers_Other %in% c(5,6)~"fair", Offers_Other %in% c(8,9)~"unfair"), levels = c("fair", "unfair")),
      emotion = factor(emotion, levels = c("neu", "aff", "dis", "dom", "enj")),
      Exp = factor(exp_label, levels = c("E1", "E2"))
    ) %>%
    filter(abs(!!sym(erp_name)) < 200)
  
  if(!is.null(baseline_col) && baseline_col %in% names(df)) {
    df$Baseline_Raw <- df[[baseline_col]]
    df$Baseline_c <- df$Baseline_Raw - mean(df$Baseline_Raw, na.rm=TRUE)
  } else { df$Baseline_c <- 0 }
  
  return(df)
}

```

```{r stats-engine}
# ==============================================================================
# Analytical Engine: 3-Way Mixed-Effects Modeling
# ==============================================================================
run_crossexp_analysis <- function(data, erp_name, out_dir) {
  
  sub_dir <- file.path(out_dir, erp_name)
  if(!dir.exists(sub_dir)) dir.create(sub_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  
  cat(sprintf("\n>>> Analyzing Component: %s [Cross-Experiment] (Total N = %d)\n", 
              erp_name, n_distinct(data$Subject_ID_Mega)))
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Fixed Effects: 3-Way Interaction
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  baseline_formula <- "+ Baseline_c"
  fixed_effects <- paste0(erp_name, " ~ Exp * emotion * offer_type ", baseline_formula)

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Random Effects Structure Optimization
  # Utilizing the newly created, safe 'Subject_ID_Mega' as the grouping factor.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  cat("   [Phase 1] Optimizing Random Structure...\n")
  random_maximal <- "+ (1 | Subject_ID_Mega) + (0 + emotion | Subject_ID_Mega) + (0 + offer_type | Subject_ID_Mega) + (0 + emotion:offer_type | Subject_ID_Mega)"
  
  f_buildmer <- as.formula(paste(fixed_effects, random_maximal))
  
  bm_res <- buildmer::buildmer(
    formula = f_buildmer, data = data,
    buildmerControl = buildmerControl(
      include = as.formula(paste("~", str_split(fixed_effects, "~")[[1]][2])),
      direction = c("order", "backward"), crit = "LRT", quiet = TRUE,
      args = list(control = custom_control)
    )
  )
  
  cat("   [Phase 2] Fitting final 3-Way model...\n")
  FINAL_MODEL <- lmer(formula(bm_res@model), data = data, REML = TRUE, control = custom_control)
  
  anova_res <- anova(FINAL_MODEL, type = 3, ddf = "Satterthwaite")
  anova_apa <- format_anova_apa(anova_res)
  print(anova_apa %>% select(Effect, APA_Report))

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Post-hoc Decompositions
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  list_of_tables <- list("ANOVA_Main" = anova_apa)
  p_3way <- anova_res["Exp:emotion:offer_type", "Pr(>F)"]
  
  if (!is.na(p_3way) && p_3way < 0.05) {
    cat("      -> Significant 3-Way Interaction detected! Decomposing by Experiment...\n")
    list_of_tables[["Simple_Offer_by_Emo_Exp"]] <- format_posthoc_apa(
      pairs(emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, as.formula("~ offer_type | emotion * Exp"), at = list(Baseline_c=0)), adjust="fdr")
    )
    list_of_tables[["Exp_Differences_by_Cond"]] <- format_posthoc_apa(
      pairs(emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, as.formula("~ Exp | emotion * offer_type"), at = list(Baseline_c=0)), adjust="fdr")
    )
  } else {
    cat("      -> No robust 3-Way interaction. Reporting 2-Way Interactions and Main Effects.\n")
    list_of_tables[["2Way_Exp_Offer"]] <- format_posthoc_apa(pairs(emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, ~ offer_type | Exp), adjust="fdr"))
    list_of_tables[["2Way_Emo_Offer"]] <- format_posthoc_apa(pairs(emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, ~ offer_type | emotion), adjust="fdr"))
    list_of_tables[["Main_Effect_Exp"]] <- format_posthoc_apa(pairs(emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, ~ Exp), adjust="fdr"))
  }

  list_of_tables[["Descriptive_Means_SE"]] <- as.data.frame(emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, ~ Exp * offer_type * emotion, at = list(Baseline_c=0)))
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Data Export & Visualization
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  wb <- createWorkbook()
  for(sheet_name in names(list_of_tables)) {
    addWorksheet(wb, substr(sheet_name, 1, 31))
    writeData(wb, substr(sheet_name, 1, 31), list_of_tables[[sheet_name]])
  }
  saveWorkbook(wb, file.path(sub_dir, paste0("STATS_CrossExp_", erp_name, ".xlsx")), overwrite = TRUE)

  pd <- as.data.frame(emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, ~ Exp * offer_type * emotion, at = list(Baseline_c = 0)))
  p_final <- ggplot(pd, aes(x = emotion, y = emmean, color = offer_type, group = offer_type)) +
       facet_wrap(~Exp, labeller = labeller(Exp = c("E1"="Exp 1: Sequential", "E2"="Exp 2: Simultaneous"))) +
       geom_line(linewidth=1.2, position=position_dodge(0.2)) + 
       geom_point(size=3.5, shape=21, fill="white", stroke=2, position=position_dodge(0.2)) +
       geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=emmean-SE, ymax=emmean+SE), width=0.2, position=position_dodge(0.2)) +
       scale_color_manual(values = colors_off, labels = labels_off) + scale_x_discrete(labels = labels_emo) +
       labs(title = paste("Cross-Experiment:", erp_name, "Interaction"), y = "Amplitude (µV)", x = "Emotion Condition")
  
  ggsave(file.path(sub_dir, paste0("Plot_CrossExp_", erp_name, ".png")), p_final, width = 10, height = 6)
  cat("   >>> Complete.\n")
}

```

```{r execution}
# ==============================================================================
# Execution Phase
# ==============================================================================
root_E1 <- here("data", "02_Pipeline_Output_E1")
root_E2 <- here("data", "02_Pipeline_Output_E2")

path_E1 <- file.path(root_E1, "Method_Regression", "Stimulus_Locked", "trials.csv")
path_E2 <- file.path(root_E2, "Method_Regression", "Stimulus_Locked", "trials.csv")

if(file.exists(path_E1) && file.exists(path_E2)) {
  cat("\n=== Processing Stimulus-Locked Components (Cross-Experiment) ===\n")
  
  for (comp_name in names(shared_components)) {
    baseline_col_name <- paste0("Baseline_", comp_name)
    
    df_e1 <- load_and_prep_single(path_E1, comp_name, baseline_col_name, "E1")
    df_e2 <- load_and_prep_single(path_E2, comp_name, baseline_col_name, "E2")
    
    if (!is.null(df_e1) && !is.null(df_e2)) {
      df_combined <- bind_rows(df_e1, df_e2)
      run_crossexp_analysis(df_combined, comp_name, out_root)
    } else {
      cat(sprintf("   [SKIP] Data missing for %s in one or both experiments.\n", comp_name))
    }
  }
} else {
  stop("CRITICAL ERROR: Could not find data files for E1 and/or E2. Please ensure both upstream pipelines have completed.")
}
```
